connection.text: Connection Name*Give your connection a unique name to help you identify it in the future.Slack*Slack CloudSlack Server (to be supported)If you are using Slack Cloud, you do not need to enter the endpoint URL, which is https://slack.com/api/.Slack Bot Token*Create a Slack App with the necessary permissions and use the Bot User OAuth Token (starts with xoxb-).ProxyAdd a proxy if you cannot access Slack directly.Custom Rate LimitBy default, DevLake uses 3,000 requests/hour for data collection for Slack. You can adjust the collection speed by setting a custom rate limit. Learn more
